cancer_indication: FDA-approved (May 2019) for HR+, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with activating PIK3CA mutations, in combination with fulvestrant after progression on endocrine therapy.
moa: Alpelisib is a highly selective ATP-competitive inhibitor of PI3K p110α (PIK3CA). It prevents phosphorylation of PIP₂ to PIP₃, thereby blocking activation of AKT and downstream mTOR signaling. In HR+ cancers, inhibiting PI3Kα interferes with cross-talk between the estrogen receptor (ER) and growth-factor pathways, so combining alpelisib with an ER antagonist (e.g. fulvestrant) produces synergistic anti-proliferative effects. In practice, alpelisib treatment reduces phosphorylated AKT and S6K in tumor cells, triggering G₁ arrest and apoptosis of PIK3CA-driven breast cancer cells.

REACTOME_PI3K_AKT_ACTIVATION.description: PI3K–AKT signaling transduces growth-factor and oncogenic cues into downstream survival and proliferation programs via activation of AKT and downstream effectors.
REACTOME_PI3K_AKT_ACTIVATION.interpretation:
This is the direct target pathway impacted by alpelisib in breast cancer, and its activity is central to growth and endocrine resistance in PIK3CA-mutant HR+ tumors.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- Alpelisib is active when the PI3Kα pathway is activated (PIK3CA driver mutations). Clinical benefit shown in PIK3CA-mutant, HR+ HER2− breast cancer (SOLAR-1). (PubMed)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: High baseline PI3K/AKT activation from PIK3CA gain-of-function in HR+/HER2– breast cancer indicates PI3Kα dependence; alpelisib + fulvestrant significantly improves PFS in PIK3CA-mutated tumors (SOLAR-1).

Alpelisib MOA: DrugBank DB12015, ChEMBL CHEMBL2396661, PubChem CID 56649450; PI3K/AKT pathway: Reactome R-HSA-198203, MSigDB REACTOME_PI3K_AKT_ACTIVATION (M714); SOLAR-1: André F et al. N Engl J Med 2019;380:1929–40. PMID:31091374, NCT02437318.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: When high PI3K/AKT scores are driven by PTEN loss, AKT1 mutation or intense upstream RTK (HER2/IGF1R) signalling, downstream survival can persist despite PI3Kα inhibition, leading to intrinsic or early resistance in HR+ breast cancer.
PI3K/AKT in cancer: Reactome R-HSA-2219528; PTEN/AKT1 and RTK-driven resistance to PI3K inhibitors in breast cancer (review).

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: A low bulk PI3K/AKT signature can mask a small PIK3CA-mutant, PI3K-addicted subclone; genomic PIK3CA positivity (as in SOLAR-1 selection) may still predict benefit despite low pathway expression.
MSigDB REACTOME_PI3K_AKT_ACTIVATION (M714) from Reactome R-HSA-198203; SOLAR-1 PIK3CA-mutation based selection: André F et al. PMID:31091374.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Low PI3K/AKT activation in HR+/HER2– tumors without PIK3CA mutation suggests lack of PI3K dependency, consistent with minimal added benefit of alpelisib observed in PIK3CA wild-type cohorts.
SOLAR-1 non-mutated cohort (no significant PFS gain): André F et al. PMID:31091374; PI3K/AKT pathway Reactome R-HSA-198203.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Alpelisib selectively inhibits PI3K p110α, reducing PIP3 and AKT phosphorylation; robust post-treatment PI3K/AKT downregulation in PIK3CA-mut HR+ breast cancer is associated with tumor shrinkage and prolonged PFS.
DrugBank DB12015; FDA label Piqray (alpelisib) NDA 212526; SOLAR-1 translational data: André F et al. PMID:31091374; Reactome R-HSA-198203.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Partial inhibition of PI3K/AKT can coexist with rapid compensation via MAPK, ERBB2 or ER–SRC signalling, giving biochemical PI3K suppression but little clinical benefit (adaptive resistance) in metastatic HR+ breast cancer.
BYLieve (post-CDK4/6 setting) shows heterogeneous benefit: Rugo HS et al. Lancet Oncol 2021. PMID:33794206; PI3K inhibitor resistance reviews in BC.

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Sustained upregulation of PI3K/AKT signalling under a selective PI3Kα inhibitor cannot drive sensitivity; any apparent “up” with clinical response is more likely due to sampling/analysis artifacts rather than true biology.
PI3K inhibitor pharmacology (on-target pAKT suppression required for efficacy): DrugBank DB12015; Reactome R-HSA-198203 (PI3K/AKT pathway).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Rebound or increased PI3K/AKT activity (e.g., via HER3, IGF1R or HER2 upregulation) is a well-described bypass route causing acquired resistance to PI3Kα inhibition in HR+ breast cancer.
PI3K/AKT in cancer Reactome R-HSA-2219528; RTK-mediated resistance to PI3K inhibitors (review, breast/pan-cancer).

REACTOME_MTOR_SIGNALLING.description: mTOR signaling regulates cellular growth and protein synthesis downstream of upstream pathways including PI3K/AKT, through effectors such as S6K and 4EBP1.
REACTOME_MTOR_SIGNALLING.interpretation:
mTOR pathway output is a key downstream growth program in breast cancer biology and is discussed as a major node in the PI3K/AKT/mTOR network relevant to alpelisib activity.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- Elevated mTORC1 output (p-4EBP1/p-S6) can maintain translation/growth and is a documented resistance mechanism to PI3K inhibition; targeting mTORC1 (or using mTORC1-selective inhibitors) can overcome resistance. (PubMed Central)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: PIK3CA-mut HR+ breast cancers with strong mTORC1 output (S6K/4EBP1) rely on PI3K–AKT→mTOR signalling for growth; PI3Kα blockade reduces mTOR activity and improves outcomes when added to endocrine therapy.
Reactome MTOR signalling R-HSA-165159; MSigDB REACTOME_MTOR_SIGNALLING (M27000); SOLAR-1: André F et al. PMID:31091374.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: If high mTORC1 is driven by PI3K-independent inputs (e.g., RHEB activation, nutrient sensing, prior mTOR-inhibitor rewiring), tumors may remain mTOR-addicted but relatively insensitive to upstream PI3Kα inhibition.
Reactome R-HSA-165159, R-HSA-166208; resistance to PI3K vs mTOR inhibitors in HR+ BC (cross-cancer mechanistic parallels).

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: Some PIK3CA-mut luminal tumors may signal mainly through AKT–FOXO/BCL-2 with modest mTORC1; these can still respond to PI3Kα blockade because survival rather than growth is PI3K-dependent.
Reactome PI3K/AKT in cancer R-HSA-2219528; REACTOME_MTOR_SIGNALLING (M27000) as downstream branch.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Low mTOR signalling in ER+ breast cancer without strong PI3K activation suggests limited reliance on PI3K–mTOR axis, matching the modest benefit in PIK3CA-WT patients in SOLAR-1.
SOLAR-1 PIK3CA-WT subgroup: André F et al. PMID:31091374; Reactome R-HSA-165159.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Effective PI3Kα inhibition reduces mTORC1 signalling, decreasing protein synthesis and cell growth; treatment-induced downregulation of REACTOME_MTOR_SIGNALLING is aligned with clinical response in HR+/HER2–, PIK3CA-mutated disease.
Reactome R-HSA-165159, R-HSA-166208; SOLAR-1/ BYLieve translational data: Rugo HS et al. PMID:33794206.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Even with mTORC1 down, breast tumors may survive via autophagy, ER/MAPK cross-talk or metabolic rewiring; in such rare cases, mTOR transcriptional downshift does not translate into durable tumor control.
mTOR inhibition and adaptive survival (autophagy, pathway rewiring) in breast and solid tumors (cross-cancer extrapolation).

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Sustained mTOR activation in the presence of an effective PI3Kα inhibitor would contradict its upstream position; any apparent “up” with clinical sensitivity likely reflects measurement noise rather than true biology.
Reactome R-HSA-165159 topology (PI3K→AKT→mTOR); Piqray label requiring on-pathway pharmacodynamic effect FDA 212526.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Persistent or increased mTOR signalling after alpelisib indicates that growth-factor or nutrient inputs continue to drive mTORC1, constituting a logical resistance mechanism in luminal breast cancer.
Reactome R-HSA-165159; PI3K/mTOR pathway resistance reviews in HR+ BC.

REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_ERBB2.description: ERBB2/HER2 signaling is a receptor tyrosine kinase pathway that can activate PI3K/AKT and other growth programs in breast cancer.
REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_ERBB2.interpretation:
ERBB2/HER2 signaling is described as cross-talking with PI3K signaling and is relevant to breast cancer contexts where HER2 and PI3K pathways are co-activated.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- HER2 activation can drive PI3K signaling and promote therapeutic escape; PI3Kα inhibitors may need combination (HER2 blockade) in HER2+ / PIK3CA settings — monotherapy is often insufficient. (PubMed)

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: In HER2+/PIK3CA-mut breast cancer, high ERBB2→PI3K/AKT signalling may create PI3Kα dependence and enable benefit from alpelisib when combined with anti-HER2 therapy, but this is currently a niche/off-label scenario.
Reactome Signaling by ERBB2 R-HSA-1227986; MSigDB REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_ERBB2 (M553) ; Jhaveri MS et al. Clin Cancer Res 2021 (alpelisib+trastuzumab/T-DM1 in HER2+ BC).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Very strong HER2 signalling engaging MAPK, PI3K and SRC arms can sustain growth even if PI3Kα is partly inhibited, explaining limited activity of alpelisib alone in heavily pretreated HER2+ metastatic breast cancer.
ERBB2 pathway: Reactome R-HSA-1227986; PubChem ERBB2 pathway summary (PI3K/AKT and MAPK branches).

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: In HR+/HER2– (HER2-low) PIK3CA-mut tumors, ERBB2 signalling is low and PI3K activation is mostly ER and PIK3CA-driven, which is the exact population deriving benefit from alpelisib in SOLAR-1.
SOLAR-1 design: HR+/HER2– population with tumor-tissue PIK3CA testing. André F et al. PMID:31091374; MSigDB REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_ERBB2 (M553).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: When both ERBB2 and PI3K pathway activity are low (ER-driven luminal A without PIK3CA mutation), disease remains endocrine-sensitive and gains little from PI3Kα inhibition.
EMA Piqray label restricting indication to PIK3CA-mut HR+/HER2– disease. (European Medicines Agency (EMA))

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: Alpelisib does not directly target ERBB2, but effective downstream PI3K inhibition plus HER2-directed antibodies can functionally dampen ERBB2 survival signalling and yield responses in HER2+/PIK3CA-mut breast cancer.
Reactome R-HSA-1227986; Jhaveri MS et al. Clin Cancer Res 2021 (T-DM1+alpelisib in HER2+ MBC).
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Loss of ERBB2 signalling after prior HER2 therapy with persistent progression suggests that tumor cells have switched drivers (e.g., MAPK, cell cycle), making further PI3Kα blockade relatively ineffective.
HER2-refractory HER2+ BC with alternative pathway dominance (post-T-DM1/T-DXd literature, extrapolated to PI3K combinations).

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Sustained ERBB2 pathway upregulation under alpelisib-containing regimens would normally promote survival and resistance; true sensitivity with ERBB2 “up” would be biologically inconsistent.
ERBB2 network: Reactome R-HSA-1227986; ERBB2 amplification and resistance paradigms in HER2+ BC.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Upregulation or amplification of ERBB2/HER3 following PI3Kα inhibition can reactivate PI3K and MAPK pathways and is a logical bypass route, promoting resistance to alpelisib-based therapy.
ERBB2 signalling modules: Reactome R-HSA-1227986; drug-mediated ERBB2 signalling and escape: Reactome R-HSA-9652282.

REACTOME_ESR_MEDIATED_SIGNALING.description: ESR-mediated signaling reflects estrogen receptor (ER) signaling programs that regulate transcriptional outputs and luminal breast cancer behavior.
REACTOME_ESR_MEDIATED_SIGNALING.interpretation:
ER signaling is described as a major driver in HR+ breast cancer and is relevant to alpelisib use in combination with ER antagonism to suppress ER-driven biology.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- Alpelisib was developed and approved for HR-positive (ER+) PIK3CA-mutant advanced BC in combination with endocrine therapy (fulvestrant); the key predictor is PIK3CA mutation in the HR+ context. The statement “ER signaling Down → Sensitive” confuses treatment effect (ER target down after fulvestrant) with the baseline predictor. (PubMed)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: HR+/HER2– PIK3CA-mutated tumors with strong ESR-mediated signalling represent classic luminal cancers with PI3K-mediated endocrine resistance, where adding alpelisib to ER-targeted therapy restores disease control.
ESR-mediated signalling: Reactome R-HSA-8939211, MSigDB REACTOME_ESR_MEDIATED_SIGNALING (M27794) ; SOLAR-1 HR+ cohort: André F et al. PMID:31091374.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Excessively high ESR signalling due to ESR1 mutations or strong RTK cross-talk can maintain ER-driven proliferation even if PI3K is inhibited, reducing alpelisib benefit unless ER is effectively degraded (e.g., SERDs).
ESR1 mutation/endocrine resistance in HR+ MBC (review); ESR pathway Reactome R-HSA-8939211.

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: Some ER-low but PIK3CA-mut HR+ tumors remain PI3K-addicted with residual ER dependence; in this subset, alpelisib can still provide benefit when combined with endocrine therapy.
ESR-mediated signalling differences between ER-high and ER-low breast cancer.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: ER-low or ESR-silenced tumors lacking clear PI3K addiction often behave more like basal/TNBC and do not fall into the approved HR+/HER2–, PIK3CA-mutated population, making alpelisib use inappropriate or ineffective.
ESR-negative/basal-like biology in breast cancer; ESR pathway: Reactome R-HSA-8939211.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: In HR+ disease, effective alpelisib plus endocrine therapy should reduce ER target-gene expression and ESR-mediated signalling, reflecting restored endocrine sensitivity and tumor control.
Reactome R-HSA-8939211; STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS downregulation as ER response marker: MSigDB STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS (M9678). (GSEA MSigDB)
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: If ESR signalling is effectively suppressed but tumor growth persists via PI3K-independent circuits (e.g., HER2/MAPK, cell-cycle lesions), breast tumors may remain clinically resistant despite low ER pathway scores.
ESR-independent proliferation mechanisms in ER+ BC; Reactome R-HSA-8939211.

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: True therapeutic sensitivity would not be expected alongside sustained or increased ESR-mediated signalling on combined PI3Kα and ER-targeted therapy; such a pattern would more likely drive resistance.
ESR signalling biology: Reactome R-HSA-8939211; endocrine resistance paradigms in ESR1-mutant BC.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Persistent or increased ESR-mediated signalling despite alpelisib + endocrine therapy implies ligand-independent ER or strong growth-factor activation, a hallmark resistance mechanism in HR+ breast cancer.
ESR pathway Reactome R-HSA-8939211; ESR1 mutation data in metastatic ER+ BC (e.g., EMERALD, elacestrant studies – cross-drug endocrine resistance pattern).

KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS.description: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis pathways govern cellular glucose metabolism and energy generation through core glycolytic enzymes and associated metabolic steps.
KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS.interpretation:
Glucose metabolism is discussed as part of metabolic adaptations in alpelisib-resistant models, making glycolysis/gluconeogenesis relevant in the breast cancer context described.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- PI3K pathway and downstream AKT/mTOR regulate glucose metabolism; PI3K inhibitor resistance is often accompanied by metabolic rewiring (increased glycolysis or alternate fuel use), and targeting metabolism can sensitize resistant cells in preclinical models. (PubMed Central)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: PI3K/AKT/mTOR promotes glycolysis; glycolysis-high, PIK3CA-mut luminal breast cancers (KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS signature) are metabolically PI3K-dependent and vulnerable to alpelisib.
KEGG pathway hsa00010; MSigDB KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS ; PI3K–Warburg effect reviews.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: When glycolysis is primarily driven by MYC or HIF-1α rather than PI3K, glycolysis-high tumors may maintain ATP and biomass despite PI3Kα blockade and thus show limited benefit from alpelisib.
MSigDB KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS; MYC/HIF-1-driven glycolysis literature (cross-cancer extrapolation).

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: Oxidative, low-glycolysis luminal A tumors can still harbor PIK3CA mutations and be PI3K-addicted at the level of survival and cell-cycle rather than metabolism, allowing alpelisib benefit.
KEGG hsa00010; luminal A, PIK3CA-mutated BC metabolic profiling (cross-cancer extrapolation).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Low glycolytic activity often indicates slow-cycling or metabolically flexible tumors (e.g., OXPHOS-driven), particularly when PIK3CA is WT, making PI3Kα inhibition less impactful.
KEGG hsa00010; metabolic flexibility and resistance to PI3K/mTOR inhibitors.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Alpelisib reduces glucose uptake and glycolytic flux by inhibiting PI3K/AKT; decreased KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS after therapy reflects on-target metabolic inhibition associated with sensitivity in HR+ BC.
KEGG hsa00010; MSigDB KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS; PI3K-regulated metabolism in cancer reviews.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Tumors may adapt to reduced glycolysis by upregulating OXPHOS, fatty-acid oxidation or autophagy, staying viable despite glycolytic suppression and thus appearing resistant to alpelisib.
Metabolic rewiring under glycolysis or PI3K/mTOR inhibition (cross-cancer extrapolation); KEGG hsa00010.

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Sustained upregulation of glycolysis under an effective PI3Kα inhibitor would usually indicate pathway escape rather than sensitivity; true responders are expected to show reduced or stable glycolytic activity.
KEGG hsa00010; PI3K/Warburg-effect paradigms in cancer.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Persistent or increased glycolytic gene expression after alpelisib implies metabolic escape (e.g., via MYC/HIF-1α), compatible with resistance in HR+ breast cancer.
MSigDB KEGG_GLYCOLYSIS_GLUCONEOGENESIS; metabolic escape mechanisms in solid tumors.

KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.description: MAPK signaling transmits mitogenic and stress signals via RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK modules to regulate proliferation and survival.
KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.interpretation:
MAPK/ERK is described as a parallel growth pathway implicated in bypass signaling in the breast cancer context discussed for alpelisib.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- MAPK pathway activation (mutations or RTK feedback) is a well described bypass mechanism to PI3K inhibition; combined PI3K + MAPK axis targeting is a rational strategy in preclinical/clinical work. (PubMed Central)

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: If MAPK and PI3K are co-activated by shared RTKs but PI3Kα remains a co-dominant driver, alpelisib can still be beneficial, especially when MAPK signalling is only partially autonomous.
KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY: MSigDB M5890 ; RTK→MAPK/PI3K crosstalk reviews in HER2-low/HR+ BC.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Strong MAPK activation via RAS/RAF or HER2 can maintain proliferation even if PI3Kα is inhibited, creating intrinsic resistance and a classic bypass route in luminal and HER2-driven breast cancers.
KEGG MAPK signalling hsa04010; MAPK as resistance driver to PI3K inhibition (breast/pan-cancer).

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: PI3K-addicted luminal tumors with modest MAPK activation (low KEGG_MAPK_SIGNATURE) are “clean” PI3K-dominant drivers and respond well to alpelisib plus endocrine therapy.
KEGG hsa04010; luminal PI3K-dominated signalling in HR+ BC.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: When both MAPK and PI3K signatures are low in ER-driven, low-proliferation tumors, alpelisib is unlikely to add benefit; resistance here often reflects “no appropriate target” rather than classical escape.
KEGG hsa04010; SOLAR-1 PIK3CA-WT, low-proliferation subsets (post-hoc, cross-trial interpretation).

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: In some settings, PI3Kα blockade reduces RTK signalling tone, causing collateral dampening of MAPK; dual attenuation of PI3K and MAPK is associated with deeper responses in breast cancer.
KEGG hsa04010; ERBB2→MAPK→ERK modules: Reactome R-HSA-1227986.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: MAPK transcription may fall while other survival pathways (JAK–STAT, SRC, BCL-2, epigenetic programmes) dominate, leading to continued resistance despite apparent MAPK pathway downregulation.
KEGG hsa04010; PI3K/MAPK network plasticity (cross-cancer extrapolation).

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Sustained ERK/MAPK upregulation after PI3Kα inhibition would almost always favour proliferation and resistance rather than sensitivity; transient feedback spikes may occur but are not captured as a stable “up” signature.
KEGG hsa04010; RTK–RAS–ERK feedback after PI3K inhibition in preclinical models.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: MAPK upregulation (e.g., via RTK–RAS–ERK rebound) after alpelisib is a classic bypass route that restores proliferation despite PI3K pathway blockade in HR+ and HER2-driven breast cancers.
KEGG hsa04010; HER2/RTK–MAPK reactivation under PI3K inhibitor pressure (breast cancer).

HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS.description: Apoptosis is programmed cell death regulated by intrinsic and extrinsic pathways that remove damaged or stressed cells.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS.interpretation:
Apoptosis is discussed as a downstream cellular consequence when PI3K/AKT survival signaling is suppressed in the breast cancer contexts described.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- Relief of AKT survival signaling (BCL2 family, MCL1 modulation) leads to apoptosis in sensitive tumors; however degree of apoptosis varies with tumor context and co-alterations (e.g., PTEN loss, concurrent MAPK activation). (PubMed Central)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Apoptosis-primed luminal tumors (high HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS) sit closer to the death threshold, so PI3Kα inhibition more readily triggers caspase activation and tumor regression when combined with endocrine therapy.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS: MSigDB M5902 ; Liberzon A et al. Cell Syst 2015. PMID:26771021 (Hallmark set).
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: High apoptotic gene expression may be functionally blocked by BCL-2/BCL-XL/MCL-1 overexpression, so apoptosis-high HR+ tumors can still resist PI3Kα inhibition unless combined with BH3 mimetics.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS M5902; BCL-2 family-mediated resistance in ER+ BC (e.g., venetoclax combinations).

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Many PIK3CA-mut HR+ tumors exhibit apoptosis-low but proliferation-high phenotypes; PI3Kα inhibition can induce pro-apoptotic factors (e.g., BIM) and trigger cell death even from a low baseline.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS; PI3K inhibitor-induced apoptosis in ER+ BC models (preclinical, cross-cancer support).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Profound apoptosis defects (TP53 loss, high anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family) prevent efficient cell death under PI3Kα inhibition, yielding mostly cytostatic rather than cytotoxic responses.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS; p53/apoptosis deficiency and resistance to targeted therapies (including PI3K) in breast and other cancers.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Successful alpelisib therapy should increase pro-apoptotic signalling (caspases/BH3-only proteins); an increased HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS score post-treatment aligns with effective tumor cell killing.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS M5902; apoptosis induction by PI3Kα inhibition (preclinical HR+ BC data).
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: Transcript-level apoptosis upregulation without functional caspase activity (e.g., due to high BCL-2 or caspase inhibition) can give an “apoptosis-high but resistant” phenotype under alpelisib.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS; discordance between gene-set scores and functional apoptosis (cross-cancer observation).

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Durable therapeutic sensitivity requires at least some activation of apoptosis (or other lethal programmes); persistent downregulation of apoptosis genes under ongoing alpelisib would not mechanistically fit a sensitive state.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS M5902; role of apoptosis in successful targeted-therapy responses.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Failure to induce apoptosis (or further suppression of apoptotic machinery) under alpelisib indicates that tumors are escaping through survival pathways or senescence-like states, consistent with resistance.
HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS; TP53/BCL-2-driven resistance mechanisms in ER+ BC.

STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS.description: ESR1 target gene sets capture transcriptional programs regulated by estrogen receptor alpha (ESR1) in luminal breast cancer contexts.
STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS.interpretation:
ESR1-driven transcription is discussed as a key feature of HR+ breast cancer and is relevant to alpelisib use alongside ER blockade in the described setting.

Baseline-focused rationale:
- Partially Sensitive (context-dependent) (ESR1 mutations often cause endocrine resistance; alpelisib + fulvestrant can still have activity) ESR1 activating mutations drive endocrine resistance but combining PI3Kα inhibition with ER downregulation (fulvestrant) can have activity in some settings; evidence is mixed and depends on prior therapies (CDK4/6 exposure etc.). ESR1 mutation is not a simple “positive” predictor but combination therapy may work in some ESR1-mutant cases. (PubMed Central)

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: High STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS in luminal HR+ BC reflects active ER transcription; in PIK3CA-mutated tumors, PI3Kα inhibition plus endocrine therapy can down-modulate these targets and restore endocrine sensitivity.
MSigDB STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS (M9678) (ESR1 targets in MCF-7 BC cells). (GSEA MSigDB); Reactome ESR-mediated signalling R-HSA-8939211.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: If ESR1 is constitutively active (mutations, co-activator gains) or heavily driven by RTKs, high STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS can persist despite PI3Kα inhibition and endocrine therapy, leading to resistance.
STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS usage in ER-regulated transcriptional studies (e.g., ZMIZ1–ERα–E2F2 axis). (PMC)

Sensitive: Mechanistically rare: ER-low but PIK3CA-mutated HR+ tumors may retain partial ER programmes and strong PI3K dependence; STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS can be modest while PI3K addiction still predicts benefit from alpelisib.
MSigDB M9678; ER-low but ER-positive BC epigenetic subgroup analyses (ESR-mediated signalling).
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Low STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS signals ER-independent or basal-shifted biology, which falls outside the canonical HR+/HER2–, PIK3CA-mutated indication and is less likely to benefit from PI3Kα inhibition.
MSigDB STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS; ESR-mediated signalling differences by ER status in BC.

Sensitive: Mechanistically accurate: Under effective alpelisib + endocrine therapy, ER target genes in STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS should be suppressed, reflecting on-target ESR pathway inhibition and clinical benefit in HR+ breast cancer.
MSigDB M9678; ESR-mediated signalling Reactome R-HSA-8939211; SOLAR-1 endocrine plus PI3Kα regimen.
Resistance: Mechanistically rare: If STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS remains low but tumor growth persists via alternative drivers (HER2/MAPK, cell cycle, epigenetic reprogramming), alpelisib resistance reflects ER independence rather than lack of ER suppression.
STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS; endocrine-independent progression in ER+ BC (e.g., ESR1 loss, basal-like conversion).

Sensitive: Mechanistically not possible: Persistent or increased ESR1 target-gene expression under PI3Kα plus endocrine therapy would typically support proliferation and resistance, not durable sensitivity.
MSigDB M9678; ESR1-driven proliferation concepts in luminal BC.
Resistance: Mechanistically accurate: Upregulated STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS after alpelisib + endocrine therapy indicates ongoing ER-driven transcription (e.g., ESR1 mutation, co-activator gain), a hallmark of endocrine and PI3K pathway resistance in HR+ breast cancer.
STEIN_ESR1_TARGETS gene set; ESR-mediated signalling Reactome R-HSA-8939211; ESR1 mutation/endocrine resistance literature.

sensitivity_genes_up_annotations.interpretation: Presence of an activating PIK3CA mutation is described as required and predictive for response in the pivotal HR+/HER2− metastatic breast cancer trials discussed.
Activating ESR1 (ER) mutations are described as remaining sensitive when estrogen signaling was blocked by fulvestrant plus PI3K inhibition in the breast cancer context discussed.

resistance_genes_up_annotations.interpretation: High baseline activity of bypass pathways including FGFR1 amplifications is described as potentially portending lower sensitivity, and FGFR pathways are listed among expected bypass mechanisms to PI3K blockade.

resistance_genes_down_annotations.interpretation: Loss of PTEN is described as a mechanism that would confer resistance by reactivating PIP₃ signaling, based on the preclinical rationale presented.

Breast_cancer_subtype_information.HR+/HER2– (Luminal A/B): Main indication. ~28–47% harbor PIK3CA mutations. Trials (SOLAR-1, BYLieve) have shown robust benefit in this subtype. Luminal-A tumors (often co-mutated MAP3K1) have especially high response rates.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.HER2+: ~23–33% have PIK3CA mutations. PIK3CA-driven PI3K activation is a known mechanism of resistance to anti-HER2 therapy. Combining alpelisib with HER2-targeted agents (trastuzumab, tucatinib) is under active study. Preclinical HER2+ models with PIK3CA mutations benefited from adding alpelisib to anti-HER2 antibodies. No approval yet, but rationale is strong.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.TNBC/Basal-like: PIK3CA mutations are uncommon overall (8–25% in TNBC) and mainly occur in the luminal-AR (LAR) subset. AR+ TNBC exhibits ~40% PIK3CA mutation versus ~4% in AR– TNBC. In AR+ models, PI3K inhibitors dramatically reduce viability when combined with AR blockade. Thus, for basal-like/BRCA1-mutant TNBC, which lack PIK3CA and AR, alpelisib is not generally effective.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.HER2-enriched (PAM50): These often overlap HER2+/some HR+ tumors. If PIK3CA-mutant, they may respond similarly to HER2+ cases; data are sparse.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.Luminal A vs B: Both are HR+, but luminal A tends to have higher PIK3CA rates and better PI3Ki sensitivity. Luminal B (higher proliferation, possible lower PI3K dependence) shows less clear benefit.
